title: Teen Boy Working on Outdoor Craft Project, 1970s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white square snapshot from around 1972 featuring a teenage boy engaged in a woodworking or outdoor craft project. Standing beside a improvised wooden workbench in a sunny yard backed by dense vines, he holds a small tube, possibly of glue or finish, while working on long wooden oars or beams laid across the table.
